about: StoneRoadMap kit texture candidates not in use. The first colour pass (rusty-riders #10761, 2026-11-12): wall-6, floor-6 and trim-3 were the kit's textures until Patch replaced them with grace's Direction B pack the same day (they read as a pastel funhouse: per-stone tints, crazy paving, a floor brighter than the walls); the others were ranked below them. How they were made is in each entry. Moving a pair into content/art/textures/stoneroad with its entry makes it available to the kit recipe again.
